steps.en: Clone the repo and install its requirements; the ONNX models ship in model/
steps.zh: 克隆仓库装好依赖，ONNX 模型已随仓库放在 model/ 里

steps.en: Save the captcha image and hand its path to the recognizer
steps.zh: 把验证码图片存下来，把路径交给识别器

steps.en: A YOLO detector boxes every glyph, splitting prompt glyphs from the ones to click
steps.zh: YOLO 检测器框出每个字，分开提示字和待点击的字

steps.en: A Siamese network scores every prompt/candidate pair and picks the best overall match
steps.zh: 孪生网络给每对提示字和候选字打相似分，整体取最优匹配

steps.en: Returns the boxes (or centre points) already in the order they must be clicked
steps.zh: 按需要点击的顺序返回框坐标（或中心点）

steps.en: Click those points with your own browser automation
steps.zh: 用你自己的浏览器自动化依次点这些坐标

value.en: A working CPU-only click-select solver for Chinese glyphs without building detection + matching yourself
value.zh: 现成的纯 CPU 中文点选识别流程，不用自己拼检测和匹配两段模型

sources: https://github.com/MgArcher/Text_select_captcha#-快速开始 (git clone, pip install -r requirements.txt, python service.py, Python API: cap = TextSelectCaptcha(), cap.run(image_path), cap.run_dict(image_path); returned order is the click order)
https://github.com/MgArcher/Text_select_captcha#-技术架构 (YOLO detection, Siamese matching, ONNX export for CPU inference)

https://github.com/MgArcher/Text_select_captcha/blob/main/src/captcha.py (TextSelectCaptcha loads model/best_v3.onnx + pre_model_v7.onnx; run(): split boxes by class, reason_all_batch, find_overall_index_fast)
